sections.title: From ODEs to PDEs: The Concept of Multivariable Change
lecture_lines: ODEs track a single point's movement over time.
PDEs describe fields, like heat on a rod.
Transition from tracking points to mapping spatial fields.
animations: Display ODE equation: f'(t) = k*f(t). Animate a single moving point.
Display PDE equation: u_t = f(u_x, u_xx). Animate a field/surface changing over time.
Transition animation: Zoom out from a point to show the entire field.

sections.title: The Heat Equation: Visualizing Diffusion
lecture_lines: The Heat Equation models how diffusion spreads heat.
It follows the formula: u_t = αu_xx.
Visualize temperature evening out across a metal rod.
animations: Display Heat Equation: u_t = \\alpha u_{xx}. Use MathTex.
Show initial hot spot as a high peak on a 1D line chart.
Animate the peak flattening and spreading over time (diffusion).

sections.title: Boundary and Initial Conditions: Setting the Scene
lecture_lines: PDEs need constraints to find unique solutions.
Initial conditions define the state at time zero.
Boundary conditions define behavior at the domain edges.
animations: Show a 2D surface of a pool. Label with 'PDE Solution Domain'.
Animate initial pulse (t=0) as a sudden ripple in the center.
Animate waves reaching the boundary and reflecting, labeled 'Boundary Condition'.

sections.title: The Wave Equation: Oscillations in Space-Time
lecture_lines: The Wave Equation describes oscillatory motion over time.
It uses second-order time derivatives: u_tt = c²u_xx.
Disturbances propagate as waves through a medium.
animations: Display Wave Equation: u_{tt} = c^2 u_{xx}. Use MathTex.
Animate a string oscillating up and down periodically.
Highlight wave propagation along the x-axis, emphasizing motion.

sections.title: Conclusion and Real-World Impact
lecture_lines: PDEs are the fundamental language of nature.
They model fluid flow, electromagnetism, and structures.
They connect spatial geometry to temporal change perfectly.
animations: Show quick 1-second animations of wave, diffusion, and flow.
Final summary slide: 'PDEs are the Language of Nature'.
